overview.title: Platform Overview
overview.content: AI Cell Platform is a continuously evolving cell image analysis system. This platform integrates multiple deep learning models (Cellpose, CellViT, CellSAM), traditional image processing methods, and machine learning techniques for cell segmentation, morphological analysis, and screening research.

tab1.title: 📤 Image Segmentation
tab1.description: Core segmentation functionality with multiple algorithms and deep learning models
features: **Traditional Methods**: Otsu threshold, adaptive threshold, watershed algorithm, Canny edge detection
**Deep Learning Models**: Cellpose (cyto2/cyto/nuclei), CellViT, CellSAM with GPU acceleration
**Postprocessing**: Region closing, individual cell extraction, morphological feature extraction
**Advanced Features**: Hu moments, intensity statistics, texture (GLCM), boundary complexity, shape features
tab1.usage: 1. Upload cell image → 2. Select segmentation method → 3. Configure preprocessing/postprocessing → 4. Click 'Start Segmentation' → 5. View results and download

tab2.title: 🔍 Comparison Mode
tab2.description: Compare results from different segmentation methods side-by-side
features: Quantitative metrics comparison (cell count, average area, circularity)
tab2.usage: Select multiple methods → Upload image → Start comparison → Analyze differences in results

tab3.title: 🔀 Model Fusion
tab3.description: Combine multiple model predictions using Dempster-Shafer theory
features: Dempster-Shafer evidence fusion for improved accuracy
tab3.usage: Select models to fuse → Upload image → System automatically combines predictions → View fused result with confidence map

tab4.title: 📦 Batch Processing
tab4.description: Process multiple images efficiently with parallel processing
features: Batch export of results (images, masks, features)
tab4.usage: Upload multiple images → Select method and parameters → Start batch processing → Download all results as ZIP

tab5.title: 🔬 Cell Morphology Extraction
tab5.description: Extract detailed morphological features from segmented cells
features: **Basic Features**: Area, perimeter, circularity, aspect ratio, solidity
**Advanced Features**: Hu moments, intensity statistics, texture (GLCM), boundary complexity
Export features to CSV/Excel for further analysis
Physical dimension calculation with pixel size calibration
tab5.usage: Upload segmented image → Enable feature extraction → Select feature categories → Export feature table

tab6.title: 🔍 Anomaly Detection
tab6.description: Identify abnormal cells using unsupervised learning
features: Isolation Forest algorithm for outlier detection
tab6.usage: Upload cell features CSV → Set contamination rate → Run detection → Review flagged cells

tab7.title: 📊 Clustering Analysis
tab7.description: Group cells into clusters based on morphological similarity
tab7.usage: Upload features → Select number of clusters → Run clustering → Analyze cluster characteristics

tab8.title: 🎓 Supervised Learning
tab8.description: Train classification models with labeled cell data
features: Multiple algorithms: Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost, Logistic Regression
Model evaluation: accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score
tab8.usage: Upload labeled features CSV → Select algorithm → Train model → Evaluate performance → Export model

tab9.title: 🔄 Active Learning
tab9.description: Iteratively improve model with minimal labeling effort
features: Query most informative samples for labeling
tab9.usage: Upload unlabeled features → Train initial model → System suggests samples to label → Label and retrain → Repeat until satisfied

tab10.title: 🔬 Virtual Screening
tab10.description: Apply trained models to screen large cell populations
features: Batch prediction on new cell images
Filter and export cells by predicted class
tab10.usage: Load trained model → Upload new cell images → Run screening → Review predictions → Export selected cells

gpu.title: 🚀 GPU Acceleration
gpu.description: GPU acceleration significantly improves processing speed for deep learning models
requirements: **Supported GPU**: NVIDIA RTX series (RTX 5070 fully supported)
**Environment**: Must run in cellpose_gpu virtual environment
gpu.performance: GPU acceleration provides 10-50x speedup compared to CPU processing, especially for Cellpose, CellViT, and CellSAM models
troubleshooting: If GPU not detected, verify you're in cellpose_gpu environment
Check CUDA availability: python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"
Ensure GPU drivers are up to date

tips.title: 💡 Tips & Best Practices
general: **Image Quality**: Use high-resolution images with clear cell boundaries for best results
**Preprocessing**: Enable denoise and contrast enhancement for noisy images
**Method Selection**: Cellpose (cyto2) recommended for most cell types; CellViT for dense populations
**Model Fusion**: Use when single models produce inconsistent results
workflow: **Step 1**: Start with Image Segmentation to test different methods
**Step 2**: Use Comparison Mode to identify the best method for your data
**Step 3**: Apply Batch Processing for large datasets
**Step 4**: Extract morphological features for quantitative analysis
**Step 5**: Use ML modules (clustering, supervised learning) for advanced analysis
performance: Enable GPU acceleration for deep learning models (10-50x faster)
Use batch processing for multiple images to leverage parallel processing
Adjust batch_size parameter based on available GPU memory
For very large images, consider splitting into tiles
